plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official Web Programming AAS award plan page (blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/web-programming-aas.html), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85 ('For the most up-to-date award plans please refer to .../applied-science-programs.html'). Semester sequence and credit hours transcribed exactly: 15/15/15/15 = 60 credits. Choice slots ('X3XX' rows) transcribed as choice courses with the award plan's listed options; first-listed course used as the slot code. The two 'or'-linked XXXX rows in semesters 2 and 4 are single 3-credit slots (not two courses). The award plan is a suggested sequence. Prerequisites are not published per-course on the award plan; semester order is as published. No courses invented.
